Download prototype 0016.nds

Open the downloaded NDS in your Android DS emulator. Start a new game to test the opening, or import a backed-up prototype 004–015 normal save through your emulator. Emulator save states should not be transferred between builds.

This is an opening prototype, not a complete Yellow remake. Route 1 now opens after Mom gives you Running Shoes. The cashier greets you outside Viridian and escorts you into the Mart. Deliver Oak’s Parcel to receive the National Pokédex. Route 2, Viridian Forest and Pewter are open after the catching lesson. Route 3 is the next development area. Imported saves keep their caught records, but Pokédex access waits for parcel delivery. Pewter’s houses, Mart and Pokémon Center now use Yellow conversations, with HeartGold healing, PC and shop services. The museum charges 50 Pokédollars and offers Old Amber once; a new second floor houses Yellow’s upstairs visitors and exhibit dialogue using HeartGold’s existing displays. Custom exhibit models are deferred. Fossil revival will be added in Cinnabar. Brock’s interaction sound is corrected. TMs are reusable, and Rare Candies can trigger eligible level-up evolutions at level 100. Psyduck now evolves only with a Moon Stone. The bulk Rare Candy selector is still being developed. All earlier changes carry forward, and earlier downloads remain available separately.
